description: Source code for trigger emulator logic, producing electrical signals to emulate trigger signals based on a TriggerShape, including handling of PWM configurations and signal callbacks.

classes.name: TriggerEmulatorHelper
classes.description: Helper class for handling trigger emulator callbacks and signal processing.

methods.name: TriggerEmulatorHelper::handleEmulatorCallback
methods.description: Handles PWM channel state changes and triggers corresponding shaft signals.

methods.description: Sets the RPM for the trigger emulator, adjusting the PWM frequency accordingly.

methods.description: Updates the trigger shape parameters if the version has changed.

methods.description: Applies pin states for the current PWM index and invokes callback if self-stimulation is enabled.

methods.description: Initializes the trigger emulator logic, setting up PWM and callbacks.
